candidates.text: Surely Congress has the power under the Thirteenth Amendment rationally to determine what are the badges and the incidents of slavery

candidates.text: We hold that \S~1982 bars all racial discrimination, private as well as public, in the sale or rental of property

candidates.text: At the very least, the freedom that Congress is empowered to secure under the Thirteenth Amendment includes the freedom to buy whatever a white man can buy

candidates.text: Some badges of slavery remain today. While the institution has been outlawed, it has remained in the minds and hearts of many white men.
